scope: Presentation and functional feedback only; retain criteria/profile/engine/strategy version 1.9.0.

content: escaped clickable scope type and human-readable name
important view value and explicit unit

aggregation.countrySupplyRegion: Maximum known native district current-view metric inside hovered province; explicitly not a province total.
aggregation.provinceOrDistrictSupplyRegion: Maximum known fine current-view metric; explicitly not a parent total.
aggregation.demandTier: Best known confirmed fine Demand tier within scope, with unresolved evidence kept separate.
aggregation.supplyPoints: Exact count of currently filtered coordinate records inside hovered source-display boundary, not the viewport count or full branch inventory.
aggregation.missing: Pending and missing are distinct from known zero; intervals remain intervals.

lifecycle: replace current scope tooltip on new hover
hover.focusAndTouch: Keyboard focus opens the same single tooltip at source bounds centre; touch selection retains detail. Actual screen-reader/physical-device certification remains unverified.
hover.tooltipTransition: Reuse one Leaflet tooltip across target changes; final clear immediately detaches prior tooltip DOM after removal, preventing overlapping fade-out remnants.
hover.accessibleGeometry: Only navigation hit geometries expose button/tabindex/area labels; analytical paint paths aria-hidden, without button role or tabindex. Keyboard focus uses the same name/value tooltip.

tooltipPresentation.meaning: Readable name/value rows; preserves source boundaries and map camera.

supplyPoints.boundaryPolicy: Quiet contextual parent outlines; omit unnecessary child outline networks at broad scopes, preserve yellow clickable hover and white selected outline.

actionGuidance.subject: a separate pointer-inert shortlist-success cue; not the actual logo, area geometry, evidence or map layer
actionGuidance.userBenefit: Show that a successful save went to Shortlist and increment its visible count by one.
actionGuidance.trigger: successful committed target state change, receipt-deduped; +1 for new/unarchived active target, -1 for removal, no +1 for an existing plan update
actionGuidance.countAuthority: actual current-context active shortlist records after successful save, never an animation counter
actionGuidance.duplicate: No duplicate target/event or false +1; say already shortlisted.
actionGuidance.failure: No success cue or +1; retain usable retry/error state.
destination: mobile shortlist navigation or visible menu fallback
actionGuidance.motionDecision: functional source-to-destination and finite success feedback, no decorative reveal
actionGuidance.focusPolicy: Retain source control focus and do not auto-navigate or scroll the user.
actionGuidance.reducedMotion: final-state-first: immediate real count/delta/plaintext/link; no spatial flight or moving pulse. Personal preference never emits team events.
actionGuidance.hiddenDestination: Missing/offscreen source or destination skips surrogate and still exposes saved count/status/destination link.
actionGuidance.interruption: Hidden document or pagehide cancels effects/timers and leaves real committed records/count; never performs a delayed mutation.

accessibility.liveRegion: Persistent empty role=status / aria-live=polite / aria-atomic=true created at initialization; update plaintext exactly once after successful receipt.
accessibility.visibleConfirmation: role=group with linked destination; source focus retained.

captions.th: ลดการเคลื่อนไหว

personalPreference.onEnable: cancel in-flight spatial guidance immediately and expose final count/status
personalPreference.respectsIn: action guidance, settled result/nav feedback, app smooth scroll and retained location-map focus

otherGuidance.loading: Keep existing map visible with readable pending/error state; animation never substitutes status.
otherGuidance.navigation: Finite selected-navigation icon feedback 120ms / 2px; no auto-navigation from save. Explicit navigation/focus/fit may move map under retained camera policy; no camera change for ordinary route sync.
otherGuidance.criteria: A settled result count change has finite 120ms feedback, never rerender replay. Applying team criteria gives a next-step link to Demand; count is calculated, not animated into a false result.
otherGuidance.sourceAndDestination: Only animate where it clarifies the action; no perpetual attention, identity animation or reveal-hidden primary content.

nativeStates: hover boundary has one tooltip, correct name/value and yellow outline
new shortlist action shows destination and actual count +1
duplicate/save failure does not show false success
reduced-motion has immediate usable count/status without flight
keyboard focus and narrow/desktop TH/EN light/dark content review
verification.nativeCoverage: Bounded native states, not full accessibility/device/language certification; automated timing/pointer event/failure tests are separate.
notVerified: actual pointer-hover across every boundary (native keyboard focus + automated pointer-event adapters used)
OS-reduced-motion setting itself (personal setting native; OS OR behavior automated)
